wa_freedom_fighter_2.notes: Clean layback crack directly above Shirley, finishes on a ledge below Death to Zeke (5.11a).
Dirty offwidth crack on the right, needs cleanup.

wa_house_of_the_7th_bobcat.notes: Short handcrack up a trailside block, then moderate ground to a bolt and a final short splitter; belay at a ledge with chain anchor.
Bouldery tips laybacking (crux) past 2 closely spaced bolts to a rest pod, then 5.10 crack climbing to a chain anchor.
